Assay -- .NET code analysis for AI agents

Usage: assay <command> [arguments] [options]

'assay help <command>' lists a command's arguments, options and defaults. [solution] is optional when exactly
one .sln/.slnx is in the current directory or the nearest ancestor holding any within the git working tree
(never past solutions below the current directory; a pick above it is named on stderr).

Orient:
  overview  [solution]                              Projects, sizes, languages, analysis warnings
  search    [solution] <query>                      Find types, members and files by name (ranked, not a pattern)
  deps      [solution]                              Project layers, cycles, hubs, and what needs attention
  structure [solution]                              Low-cohesion types (LCOM4), coupling ranking (Ca × Ce), type cycles, feature envy
  surfaces  [solution]                              Entry points: HTTP endpoints, Blazor pages, gRPC and hub methods, with handlers
  batch     [solution] '<query>'...                 Several single-quoted queries against one graph load; each takes its command's options

Navigate & impact:
  type      context      [solution] <type>          Numbered source, relationships and tests of a type
  type      detail       [solution] <type>          Members, bases, metrics, coupling and cohesion
  type      usages       [solution] <type>          Where a type is used (--sites: every file:line)
  type      hierarchy    [solution] <type>          Inheritance tree
  type      rels         [solution] <type>          Every incoming and outgoing edge
  member    [solution] <member>                     Callers, callees, readers/writers, test reach (--source: the body)
  impact    [solution] <subject>                    What breaks if a type or member changes: dependents, sites, tests, surfaces
  path      [solution] <from> <to>                  How A depends on B (members: the call chain)
  namespace [solution] <namespace>                  Types in a namespace
  project   summary      [so
[truncated]
